jsonTitles.Returns the estimated network fee and th: Returns the estimated network fee and the amount to receive for a refund of a blocked transaction of the store. code_required is true when the address is not a sender of the deposit: send a confirmation code to the wallet email (send-code) and pass it on the refund creation. The fee is an estimate and may change by the time of sending
jsonTitles.Sends a one-time code to the wallet emai: Sends a one-time code to the wallet email. The code confirms a refund of the blocked transaction to a destination address which is not a sender of the deposit. Pass it when creating the refund. The code can be sent again once a minute
jsonTitles.Creates a refund of a blocked transactio: Creates a refund of a blocked transaction of the store. A refund to the sender of the deposit is scheduled without a code and sent after the cooldown (status scheduled). A refund to another address requires the code sent to the wallet email (send-code) and is sent after the store owner approves it (status pending_review)
jsonTitles.Returns a refund request of the store wi: Returns a refund request of the store with its status
jsonTitles.Marks the given wallet address as dirty: Marks the given wallet address as dirty so it will not be used for new payments
jsonTitles.Get exchange rates for all currencies en: Get exchange rates for all currencies enabled on the store (rate is scale-adjusted; original_rate is without store rate_scale)

jsonTitles.Get extended list of store currencies gr: Get extended list of store currencies grouped by tokens and blockchains
